title: Uniruled Fourfolds and Mukai Lattice Cycle Reductions in Lean 4: Conditional Cycle-Class Frameworks
description: Standalone Lean 4 formalization (`UniruledFourfolds.lean`, `UniruledFourfolds/Blueprint.lean`, `UniruledFourfolds/MukaiLattice.lean`) and Python Mukai lattice signature/discriminant calculator (`scripts/mukai_lattice_calc.py`) for conditional cycle-class reductions on smooth projective uniruled fourfolds. Formalizes how middle Hodge classes reduce under cylinder/correspondence maps when a uniruled parametrization hypothesis holds. All cycle-class surjectivity deductions in this repository are conditional on explicit geometric correspondence hypotheses; this repository does not claim an unconditional proof of any open Hodge surjectivity conjecture.
